title: Into the Deep Sea
old_p1: Micah was a prophet who spoke for Heavenly Father. The people had made wrong choices. Wrong choices are sins.
But Micah knew the Lord loves to forgive. He said, “He delighteth in mercy.” Delight means to love and be glad. Mercy is kindness that forgives.
Micah said the Lord “will have compassion upon us.” Compassion is love for someone who is hurting.
old_p2: Micah said, “Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.” Cast means throw. The sea was the deepest place people knew. Things thrown there were never found again! When we are sorry, Jesus forgives us, and our sins are gone.
Tonight, pretend to toss a wrong choice far away. When you are sorry, Jesus forgives you too.
p1: Micah told the people what Heavenly Father said. The people had made many wrong choices, called sins.
But Micah knew something wonderful. He said the Lord “delighteth in mercy.” The Lord is glad to forgive!
Micah said the Lord “will have compassion upon us.” He loves us and wants to help, like a mom hugging her crying child.
p2: Micah said the Lord will throw our sins “into the depths of the sea.” The sea was the deepest place people knew. Things thrown there were never found again! When we are sorry, Jesus forgives us, and our sins are gone.
Tonight, pretend to toss a wrong choice far, far away. When you are sorry, Jesus forgives you too.
